title: Устранить дефекты клиента Forgel Code и привести проверку в исполнимый вид
requirements: R1. After `forgel-code use <key>`, each of status, tasks, task, say, plan, resume, pause, history, projects, session, accept, rework passes the selected project key to the engine, and none of them relies on the engine's default project.
R1a. A test with a fake engine that records argv asserts, for every command in R1, that the recorded arguments contain the selected key and no default-project key.

R2. With machine output enabled (`--json`), any argument-parsing failure (unknown command, extra positional, missing required argument) writes exactly one JSON object with `"ok": false` and a description to stdout, writes no parser help text to stdout, and exits non-zero.

R3. Every engine invocation is bounded by a timeout; when it elapses the client kills the engine, exits non-zero and emits a structured error, and returns within the timeout plus a small fixed margin.
R4. Engine stdout and stderr are decoded as UTF-8 regardless of the host locale.
R5. The engine child process is started without inheriting the client's standard input.

R6. When the engine exits non-zero and emits a structured error object, the client parses it and surfaces its fields through the same structured (machine) or rendered (human) channel used for other responses, rather than replacing it with raw stdout/stderr text.
R7. An engine response with `"ok": false` and exit code 0 is treated as a failed engine call and makes the client exit non-zero.

R8. Global flags (machine output, engine path) are parsed as positional-free options so argument text is preserved: arguments that merely contain similar words and remarks beginning with a hyphen reach the engine byte-for-byte unchanged.
R9. Task lookup by identifier resolves exactly one task; a nested object that merely carries an id field is never accepted as the task; ambiguity or absence produces an error.
R10. Detection of a missing engine command uses a stable property of the engine response, not substrings of the human-readable error message.
R11. The project field in machine output reports the project actually used for the call; when no project is selected no default label is substituted.
R12. `forgel-code --version` prints the client version and exits 0; when a call fails, the error message identifies which engine responded (engine identity/version or path).
R13. `plan` distinguishes goal text from a milestone name; goal text is sent to the engine as goal text and is never sent as a milestone name.
R14. The built source distribution is named `forgel_code-<version>` and contains the package metadata at the archive root.
R15. The built wheel contains the package subpackages, the type file and the data files, not only top-level modules.
R16. The package version is declared in exactly one place and consumed by both the package metadata and the build backend.

R17. The README install instructions install a pinned copy (a specific commit, tag or built package), not the default branch and not a development/editable install, and describe upgrading over an installed copy.
R18. Each fixed item R1-R17 has a test that fails on the pre-fix code and passes after the fix.
R19. The whole suite runs with one command from the client repository root (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`) and exits 0 without import errors.
acceptance: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` run from the client repository root exits with code 0 and reports no import errors.

A test with a fake engine that records argv shows that, after `forgel-code use <key>`, each of status, tasks, task, say, plan, resume, pause, history, projects, session, accept and rework forwards the selected key to the engine.

With `--json` and deliberately invalid arguments (unknown command, extra positional argument), the client prints exactly one JSON object with `"ok": false`, exits non-zero, and prints no parser help text to stdout.
A fake engine that hangs longer than the configured limit causes a non-zero exit and a structured error within the limit plus a margin.
An engine response with a non-zero exit code and an error object delivers that error object's fields to the user.
An engine response with `"ok": false` and exit code 0 makes the client exit non-zero.
A test shows that `forgel-code say "добавь флаг --json"` sends the complete text to the engine with no words lost or altered.
A test shows that `plan` with goal text sends the goal text to the engine, not a milestone name.
The source archive is named `forgel_code-<version>` and holds the package metadata at its root; the wheel contains the subpackages and the type file; both are asserted by a packaging test.
The README contains no default-branch install and no development/editable install, and pins installation to a commit, tag or built package, with an upgrade procedure.
The full test suite is green and no pre-existing test has been deleted or weakened.
constraints: Клиент остаётся тонким: он не обращается к модели, не читает файлы проекта и не выполняет проверки сам.
Клиент не импортирует код движка; взаимодействие только через отдельный процесс и параметризованные команды.
Согласованный машинный формат: при машинном выводе ровно один JSON-объект в stdout, код 0 при успехе, ненулевой код и "ok": false при ошибке.
Изменения только в репозитории клиента; движок и его контракт команд не меняются.
Публичные артефакты — на английском; ответы в чате — на русском.
Тесты не запускают внешние сервисы и не требуют сети.
assumptions: Целевой репозиторий — code: задача целиком про клиент Forgel Code, который живёт в отдельном репозитории и не импортирует движок.

Проверка задаётся запуском по каталогу тестов из корня репозитория, а не адресацией модулей: прошлый прогон показал, что адресация модулей в окружении исполнения не работает, а запуск по каталогу проходит полностью. Это обратимое решение и не меняет структуру тестов.
Агент должен сначала свериться с текущим состоянием файлов, потому что часть исправлений могла быть внесена прошлым прогоном, и не переписывать уже корректное.
Ограничение по времени вызова движка выбирается консервативным значением по умолчанию с возможностью переопределения через переменную окружения; конкретное значение — на усмотрение реализации.
Два ранее непроверенных критерия (установка не с плавающей ветки и доказательство падения новых тестов на исходном коде) входят в эту задачу и проверяются в её приёмке.

external_dependencies.name: forgel engine CLI
external_dependencies.interface: The client spawns `forgel <command> ...` via `subprocess.run` with a timeout, `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL`, UTF-8 decoding, parses one JSON object from stdout, and uses the exit code. Tests use the deterministic executable below, selected through the engine-path flag or `FORGEL_BIN`; `FORGEL_STUB_LOG` records exact argv/project propagation, while `FORGEL_STUB_SLEEP`, `FORGEL_STUB_STDOUT`, and `FORGEL_STUB_EXIT` exercise timeout and structured-error paths.
external_dependencies.docs: Project decision log D-007 and the task dependency contract for the `forgel` CLI JSON/exit-code protocol.
external_dependencies.evidence: D-007 records the engine protocol: one JSON object on stdout, `forgel say` as the only free-text entry point, active project as an engine session with default key `local`, and structured `ok:false` errors. Acceptance criteria R1, R6, R7, R10, and R12 require preserving project keys, parsing engine error objects, treating `ok:false` as failure, detecting unsupported commands by a stable response signal, and reporting engine identity. No repository in the project list provides the engine itself (only `main` and `code`, both application repos), so a documented stub is used.

external_dependencies.name: Python standard library
external_dependencies.interface: Use `subprocess.run(..., timeout=..., stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, encoding='utf-8')`; `json` for the engine envelope; `unittest` for tests; a parser for global flags before subcommands.
external_dependencies.evidence: Python 3 standard library is the repository runtime, and the dependency contract explicitly names `subprocess`, `json`, `unittest`, and a parser. The `subprocess` documentation defines `timeout`, explicit `stdin`, and explicit text `encoding`, which map to requirements R3, R4, and R5.

external_dependencies.name: PEP 625 source distribution naming
external_dependencies.interface: `_build_backend.py` emits the sdist as `forgel_code-<version>.tar.gz` and writes `PKG-INFO`/package metadata at the archive root; the packaging test inspects the result with `tarfile`.
external_dependencies.evidence: PEP 625 specifies the canonical sdist filename and requires package metadata (`PKG-INFO`) at the archive root. The project requirement R14 requires the archive name `forgel_code-<version>` with package metadata at the root, and R16 requires one shared version source.

external_dependencies.name: PyPA `build` / packaging backend
external_dependencies.interface: Call the project's local `_build_backend.py` directly for `build_sdist` and `build_wheel` from the packaging test; optionally invoke `python -m build --no-isolation` only if the external `build` module is installed.
external_dependencies.evidence: The dependency contract names the project's `_build_backend.py` as the build backend, and `pyproject.toml` declares that backend. The packaging test can import and call it directly, so PyPA `build` is optional and no network or build isolation is required. Requirements R14-R16 verify sdist name, wheel contents, and single-source version.

result.summary: Проверил текущее состояние репозитория после прерванного прошлого прогона: все требования спецификации уже реализованы в дереве, менять ничего не потребовалось — этот прогон не вносил правок. Подтверждение: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` из корня репозитория завершается с кодом 0, прогоняются 96 тестов (без пропусков и ошибок импорта), включая подпроцессные проверки (`tests/test_cli_extra.py`), контрактные проверки стаба движка (`tests/test_stub_contract.py`) и упаковочные проверки (`tests/test_packaging.py`, `tests/test_packaging_types.py`). Соответствие требованиям подтверждено тестами: R1/R1a — `tests/test_cli.py::ProjectPropagationTest`, `tests/test_stub_contract.py::StubContractTest::test_the_selected_key_reaches_every_scoped_command`; R2 — `tests/test_cli.py::ArgumentParseErrorTest`; R3 — `tests/test_cli.py::TimeoutTest`, `tests/test_cli_extra.py::TimeoutBoundTest`; R4/R5 — `tests/test_cli.py::EngineCallTest`; R6/R7 — `tests/test_cli.py::StructuredErrorTest`, `tests/test_cli_extra.py::StructuredErrorPassthroughTest`; R8 — `tests/test_cli_extra.py::ExactPhraseTest`; R9 — `tests/test_cli.py::TaskLookupTest`; R10 — `tests/test_cli.py::MissingEngineCommandTest`; R11 — `tests/test_cli.py::ProjectPropagationTest::test_json_envelope_reports_the_project_actually_passed`; R12 — `tests/test_cli_extra.py::CliSmokeTests` и `EngineIdentityTest`; R13 — `tests/test_cli.py::PlanShapeTest`; R14/R15/R16 — `tests/test_packaging.py`, `tests/test_packaging_types.py`; R17 — `tests/test_cli.py::ReadmeTest`; R19 — общий прогон discover. Код единого пути вызова движка (`forgel_code/engine.py`) содержит таймаут, UTF-8-декодирование, `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL`, проброс структурированной ошибки и трактовку `ok: false` как отказа; CLI разбирает глобальные флаги парсером без текстовых подстановок.; task QA failed: `forgel-code --help` and `forgel-code --version` exit 0.
